tools.name: script.compile
tools.description: Compile fixed Game.cs and attach it to current project entities; commits only at the captured scene revision.

tools.name: script.job.get
tools.description: Read bounded compiler status and source diagnostics.

tools.name: script.job.cancel
tools.description: Cancel the active owned compiler process without replacing the current build.

tools.name: scene.component.add
tools.description: Attach a Renderable or the compiled C# script to an entity. Transform is mandatory; undoable.

tools.name: scene.component.remove
tools.description: Remove an optional component or detach the compiled C# script; Transform remains mandatory.

tools.name: asset.job.start
tools.description: Start bounded background import, source replacement or texture binding; query the job receipt.

tools.name: asset.job.get
tools.description: Read bounded background asset job status.

tools.name: asset.job.cancel
tools.description: Cancel the current owned asset job.

tools.name: asset.explain
tools.description: Inspect one asset and its dependency/build status.

tools.name: project.query
tools.description: List project summaries with an explicit UTF-8 response budget.

tools.name: scene.query
tools.description: Compact active scene summary. No source code or binary payloads.

tools.name: entity.query
tools.description: Page entities by literal name substring, ID or component. Cursor is offset scoped to the required scene revision.

tools.name: runtime.status
tools.description: Inspect daemon Play mode and live editor readiness. An editor is required for rendering.

tools.name: renderer.capture
tools.description: Capture an actual WebGPU color frame plus bounded semantic entity context. Requires a ready editor and current scene revision; Null returns unavailable.

tools.name: events.query
tools.description: Bounded semantic event deltas. Reports retention gaps and a continuation sequence; no binary or full-world payloads.

tools.name: diagnostics.query
tools.description: Bounded daemon/editor error deltas with trace IDs and retention-gap reporting.

tools.name: api.search
tools.description: Search real available tools by literal substring, with pagination.

tools.name: api.describe
tools.description: Describe one tool, component or stable error from canonical metadata.

tools.name: asset.query
tools.description: Page imported asset metadata without source bytes or geometry.

tools.name: workspace.begin
tools.description: Create an isolated proposal from a saved, stopped project. Source remains unchanged.

tools.name: workspace.list
tools.description: List up to eight isolated proposals.

tools.name: workspace.diff
tools.description: Inspect paged changes and a revision-bound review hash.

tools.name: workspace.log
tools.description: Inspect the bounded proposal action log.

tools.name: workspace.preview
tools.description: Run a proposal in the editor without changing the source.

tools.name: workspace.continue
tools.description: Stop preview and continue editing the isolated proposal.

tools.name: workspace.reject
tools.description: Discard a proposal and its private files; source remains unchanged.

tools.name: workspace.accept
tools.description: Human-only acceptance of the reviewed change set into the authoring draft. Save explicitly to persist.

tools.name: scene.collider.set
tools.description: Set Collider authoring component; edits are revision checked and proposal scoped.

tools.name: scene.rigidBody.set
tools.description: Set RigidBody authoring component; edits are revision checked and proposal scoped.

tools.name: diagnostics.explain
tools.description: Explain rendering, collider, resource or script decisions from live editor frame evidence. Returns bounded Decision Graph and unavailable/expired evidence explicitly; no inferred pixel visibility.

tools.name: scene.material.set
tools.description: Set the canonical material component with revision checks and Undo.

tools.name: scene.light.set
tools.description: Set the canonical light component with revision checks and Undo.

tools.name: scene.lod.set
tools.description: Set the canonical lod component with revision checks and Undo.

tools.name: scene.rendering.update
tools.description: Set HDR rendering, lighting tier and postprocessing settings with Undo.

tools.name: scene.entity.reparent
tools.description: Parent a selection atomically, retaining world TRS. Reject cycles and shear. Undo restores the complete hierarchy. Optional beforeId orders the selected roots among siblings.

tools.name: scene.primitive.create
tools.description: Create a built-in shape as an ordinary imported GLB and editable entity.

tools.name: scene.entities.update
tools.description: Atomic batch transforms in local or world space; one Undo.

tools.name: scene.entities.delete
tools.description: Delete selected subtrees atomically; one Undo.

tools.name: project.editor.update
tools.description: Persist panel sizes without saving the scene draft.

tools.name: scene.sprite2D.set
tools.description: Set bounded sprite2D through revision-checked authoring, Undo and isolated proposals.

tools.name: scene.spriteAnimation.set

tools.name: scene.tilemap.set

tools.name: scene.light2D.set
tools.description: Set bounded light2D through revision-checked authoring, Undo and isolated proposals.

tools.name: scene.particles2D.set
tools.description: Set bounded particles2D through revision-checked authoring, Undo and isolated proposals.

tools.name: scene.ui2D.set
tools.description: Set bounded ui2D through revision-checked authoring, Undo and isolated proposals.

tools.name: scene.twoD.update
tools.description: Enable/update 2D scene settings and orthographic Game camera.

tools.name: scene.animator.set
tools.description: Set bounded Animator states, clip playback, parameters and transitions with revision checks, Undo and proposals.

tools.name: animation.query
tools.description: Observed currentAnimation, transition and whyAnimationNotPlaying from a live matching editor revision, or unavailable.

tools.name: animation.control
tools.description: Apply transient pause/resume/state/parameter control to the live Play instance at this revision; never authors MAIN.

tools.name: scene.audioSource.set

tools.name: scene.audioListener.set

tools.name: scene.audio.update

tools.name: audio.query
tools.description: Observed source playhead, buses, listener and whyAudioNotPlaying, or unavailable.

tools.name: audio.control
tools.description: Transient live Play audio source/bus controls; never authors the project.

tools.name: asset.audio.read
tools.description: Read at most 4096 canonical PCM frames from an immutable project WAV.

tools.name: profiler.query
tools.description: Read bounded measured frame history from the live editor; milliseconds and timestamp availability are explicit.

tools.name: profiler.explainFrameSpike
tools.description: Compare a retained frame against prior comparable frames and rank measured contributors; unavailable evidence is explicit.
